name: Glass pull request merge
oneLiner: a pull request card on glass: three checks spin and turn green one by one, the merge button wakes up and is pressed, the branch line curves into main with a green node and the status flips from Open to Merged
say: when the speaker says the change passed and went in ('all the tests passed and I merged it', 'the agent opened a PR and it shipped'): the checks turn green on 'passed', the button is pressed and the branch merges on 'merged'
